images.name: coldOverview
images.observed: 全岛尺度下山丘、鞍部与花田连接保持完整，未见新大形开口或明显孤立浮块。单块冷岩太小，不足据此确认其完整接地。

images.name: defaultEntry
images.observed: 默认入口白路连续下降，近处坡面与树位随新地形上移，原圆丘陡面感减轻；裸地、旧树冠及规整花毯仍明显。

images.name: flowerHillReverse
images.observed: 背侧连续抬升成立，新肩体遮住更多中段白路；该图不能证明整条路始终可见或实际路面净空全部通过。可见岩体轮廓未见拉长或拍扁。

images.name: low

views.name: flowerHillSaddle

views.name: flowerHillEastLow
views.finding: Broader continuous side support; the joining ridge remains a visible soft contour. No visible cut gap or hanging trunks in this frame.

views.name: flowerHillReverse
views.finding: Continuous near shoulder; much of the middle path is now legitimately occluded by the raised terrain. Do not claim complete path visibility or improved back-view navigation. Broad bare slope remains unfinished.

views.name: low

views.name: night
views.finding: Shadows follow the new broad slope with no visible detached strip. The view is dark; this does not constitute detailed regional night-lighting refinement.
